budget.threshold_rule: per index and system on calibration days: most alerts allowed, then strictest
budget.year_cap_note: never binds given the quarter cap (stated, not tuned)

data.cleaning: drop missing or non-positive closes and duplicate dates (keep last); nothing else
source_order: stooq (whole series; never mixed with yahoo)

event_level.effect: excess per 100 alerts = 100 x sum_e (o_e - p_e) / alerts, p_e from the primary null

budget_preserving_regime.rule: alerts re-placed in random order within their own calendar quarter on evaluation days, >= 20 trading days from their own original and from every alert already placed; own rv_20 decile first, then the nearest deciles, original kept only if nothing qualifies; shares of each placement type reported

event_level.primary_statistic: number of market episodes with at least one catch (pre-onset; in-progress)

feasibility.check: F = 1 whenever H <= wmax (stop if not)

per_day.average: equal-weighted mean over indices of within-index AUCs

bootstrap.unit: calendar quarter, common to all indices

per_day.within_regime: pairs within the same index x rv_20-decile stratum (deciles over each index evaluation days)

prior_contact: no model was run on these series before this specification was frozen; notebook 30 used daily S&P 500 labels only (Appendix C.2 of the Bitcoin manuscript); general knowledge of market history is acknowledged

readings.Q1 (primary): M0, D20: supported if the 95% interval of S_in lies above 1/4, contradicted if below 1/4, inconclusive otherwise; not evaluable (inconclusive) if mean_i[AUC_i - 1/2] <= 0.02 in more than 2.5% of bootstrap draws; S_in > 1/2 reported descriptively
readings.Q2 (key, event level): H1 (in-progress) and H2 (pre-onset): episode counts above the primary null, Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 across M0, M1, GBM. Supported if H1 holds for >= 2 systems and, for each of them, the episode-bootstrap 95% interval of (in-progress excess - pre-onset excess) per 100 alerts lies above 0; contradicted if that interval lies below 0 for >= 2 systems; inconclusive otherwise
readings.Q3 (diagnostic): F for D60 at wmax = 20 reported; F < 1 expected by construction; F = 1 for D10 and D20 is a check
readings.Q4 (secondary): D60, GBM - M0 on averaged standard and pre-onset AUC: supported if both 95% intervals exclude 0 on opposite sides, contradicted if both exclude 0 on the same side, inconclusive otherwise; no direction predicted
readings.reporting: all outputs reported as observed, whatever they show

registration: OSF Registries, a separate registration linked to 10.17605/OSF.IO/TB245; data are downloaded only after it

M0.model: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.2, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=400, lbfgs, random_state=17)

systems.missing: a day is scored only if every feature is finite; the same days are used for every system
systems.training: pooled over indices; label = day lies in a D20 judging window (pre-onset and in-progress both positive); catalog built only from data before 2000-01-01; last 25 trading days before 2000 dropped

title: Pre-registered historical external validation of onset-aware crash-warning evaluation across international equity indices

window.alert_time: close of day a; credits breaches on days a+1 ... a+20
window.negatives: all other evaluation days with valid scores
window.secondary_negatives: also exclude days b ... b+20 after each breach
